svg.title: Dot product throughput by implementation
svg.desc: Bars: strict-IEEE AVX-512 code is slower than scalar; -ffast-math and one accumulator reach about 27 GFLOP/s; four accumulators reach about 70 GFLOP/s.

svg.text: A reduction is a latency chain until you give it independent accumulators
